subject: T1: ask-gate heuristic + ask-journal.jsonl
description: Build lib/ask-gate.js — the heuristic "ask-user vs predict-from-KB" preference gate, mirroring lib/context-gate.js's four-guard structure. Input: a pending dispatcher decision (question text + task context) and the recalled preference notes (reuse the existing search/embedding path). Output: { decision:'ask'|'predict', appliedNote?, reason, top1, margin, gap, locality, features }. Hard override: irreversible/high-impact/outward-facing/scope-expansion decisions ALWAYS return 'ask' regardless of confidence (mirror request_guidance's documented triggers). Expose it on the daemon (route + MCP surface) so the dispatcher can call it before request_guidance. Append every decision to a new .graph/ask-journal.jsonl (schema parallel to gate-journal.jsonl: ts, workspace, query, decision, reason, top1/margin/gap/locality, topKey, gated flag, features) so the learned gate (T3) has training data from day one. Heuristic ships LIVE. Ground the preference-note recall on notes tagged category:"preference" (the convention T2 establishes) plus general decision notes.

summary: Shipped T1 ask-vs-predict preference gate. lib/ask-gate.js mirrors lib/context-gate.js's four-guard shape (cos>=0.50 confidence floor, empirical/scar specificity via margin OR external-gap OR tag-overlap, project-locality>=2of4) adapted to "predict from a stored preference vs ask the user"; reuses context-gate's classifyNoteType/externalGap/projectLocality/contentTokens/noteText/tagOverlap helpers. Default=ask; predict returns the matched note. Hard-override (always ask) for irreversible/outward/high-impact/scope-expansion/repeated-failure — checkable via caller flags AND conservative keyword heuristics, mirroring request_guidance's trigger list. POST /ask-gate (routes/graph.js) recalls preference notes (grounded on category:"preference" + general/decision notes) via the same semantic cosine path /search uses, runs the gate, and appends every verdict to a new .graph/ask-journal.jsonl (schema parallel to gate-journal.jsonl: ts/workspace/query/decision/reason/top1/margin/gap/locality/tagOverlap/sharedTags/topType/topKey/via/override/overrideCategory/embedModel/gated/prefCands — stable for T3). Added ask_gate MCP tool (lib/mcp-core.js). test/ask-gate.test.js: 25/25 green (predict-on-match, ask-on-no-match, hard-override-always-asks, journal-append). Full suite: 118/130 files pass; the 12 failures are PRE-EXISTING on clean base (verified by stashing — daemon-port/env flakiness, none reference ask-gate). Files: lib/ask-gate.js, routes/graph.js, lib/mcp-core.js, test/ask-gate.test.js. NOTE: /ask-gate route + ask_gate tool require a daemon restart to go live.
